question: If baryonic matter is the only true source, what minimum nonlocal paths would route its gravitational influence through the locations assigned to dark matter by standard cluster lens models, and does one baryon-only routing law predict a cluster left out of the inference?

field_hypothesis.return_kernel_normalization: integral[K_theta(y|x,E_b) dy]=1 for every baryonic source x
field_hypothesis.interpretation: J is conserved baryon-sourced gravity flux. K_theta is a new nonlocal return kernel produced by spacetime curvature or an off-observable-space excursion. It redirects influence without placing a material particle at y.
field_hypothesis.strength_extension_not_tested_here: kappa_physical=A_b*B+A_arc*q*R[B]. Absolute A_b and path-multiplicity q require stellar-mass and gas maps; this stage tests normalized spatial shape only.

spatial_preprocessing.primary_source_weight: positive F160W flux times frozen soft photometric-membership weight
spatial_preprocessing.source_sensitivity: hard photometric members weighted by positive F160W flux
spatial_preprocessing.primary_target: ensemble kappa minus the 250-300 kpc annular median, clipped at zero, smoothed, and normalized to unit integral inside 300 kpc
spatial_preprocessing.target_sensitivity: positive raw ensemble kappa, smoothed and normalized inside 300 kpc
spatial_preprocessing.target_model_dependency: Every kappa target is a Lenstool standard-lens-equation reconstruction and is never called a raw observation.

inverse_tomography.method: balanced entropic optimal transport from normalized baryonic source weights to normalized apparent lensing weights
inverse_tomography.cost: squared projected physical distance in kpc
reported_path_statistics: mass-weighted mean, median, and 90th-percentile travel distance
alignment with the inward cluster direction
alignment with the baryon-generated external acceleration direction
alignment with the strongest neighboring-galaxy direction
top baryonic origins for each high-kappa destination peak
inverse_tomography.interpretation_limit: Optimal transport finds a minimum-cost attribution, not a unique physical history.

forward_laws.local_gaussian: No arc. Smooth the baryonic source map by width w.
forward_laws.central_halo_null: Ignore individual source geometry and place a Gaussian at the baryonic luminosity centroid.
forward_laws.isotropic_return: Each source returns on an isotropic ring of physical radius ell.
forward_laws.center_return: Each source lands ell toward the baryonic luminosity centroid.
forward_laws.external_field_return: Each source lands ell along the acceleration direction generated by every other selected baryonic source.
forward_laws.strongest_neighbor_return: Each source lands ell toward the other source maximizing luminosity/(distance^2+softening^2).

landing_modes.endpoint: Arc contribution appears in a Gaussian around the return point.
landing_modes.tube: Arc contribution is distributed over nine equal projected path samples from source to return point.

validation.primary_loss: Jensen-Shannon divergence between unit-normalized predicted and target shapes inside 300 kpc
validation.selection: For each leave-one-cluster-out fold and each law family, choose the single setting with minimum mean primary loss on the two training clusters. Lock it before evaluating the third cluster.
validation.overall_selection: Choose the law and setting only from the two training clusters in each fold; never use the validation target to choose a family or parameter.
validation.uncertainty: Evaluate every locked prediction against all 100 validation-cluster kappa realizations; report median and 16th-84th percentiles.
validation.useful_spatial_law_gate: All three held-out folds improve Jensen-Shannon divergence by at least 10 percent over both the local-light and central-halo null selected on the same training folds, with no held-out Pearson decrease.
validation.universal_geometry_clue: The same arc family wins at least two of three folds and its selected L0 and width remain within a factor of two.
validation.no_truth_probability: Scores are predictive morphology errors, not probabilities that dark matter is absent or the field hypothesis is true.

controls.angle_shuffle: Thirty-two deterministic source-angle shuffles preserve every source radius and weight but erase observed angular structure.
controls.identity_conservation: Every forward map has unit integral inside the computational grid before the common aperture is scored.
controls.target_blindness: Forward-law directions and endpoints use only baryonic source positions and weights.
controls.later_cross_domain_requirement: Any spatial survivor must subsequently acquire an absolute-strength closure and be tested on galaxy rotation, raw lens observables, and Solar-system bounds.
